title: ADLC active-ticket pointer (.adlc/current-ticket.json)
description: Names the one ticket in flight in this worktree. Gitignored runtime state, not tracked. The active ticket is per-worktree: parallel work on a second ticket needs its own worktree (git worktree add), not a second pointer. To deactivate, DELETE this file — an object with no recognized id key is malformed and fails closed, never 'no active ticket'. Absent this file (and ADLC_TICKET), enforcement is inert.

id.description: The active ticket id, exactly as it appears in the ticket store.

ticketHash.description: The ticket's hash at selection time. Pinning it is what makes 'the ticket changed after I selected it' detectable; a mismatch fails closed (ACTIVE_TICKET_STALE).

oneOf.title: Deprecated alias pointer (removed in 2.0)
oneOf.description: Accepted by every reader so existing pointers do not brick, reported by `adlc ticket doctor`, and never written by ADLC. The `ticketId` spelling entered the wild by being copied from the gate-manifest's evidence field name while this schema went undocumented.

oneOf.title: Legacy bare-string pointer (removed in 2.0)
oneOf.description: Pins no ticketHash, so it resolves only under the documented 1.x bridge and denies under the strict default.
